title: Reference workflow harness repository and SIT environment, seeding, evidence format and gate are not specified, and the ownership map holds no rwb-case outbox delivery read
source: Template and Rules v1 R7.2 and R9; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 11, 13, 14, 18, 20, 41, 42 and 44; Temporal and Drools Design Text Extract v1 slides 11 to 16 and 27 to 28; _work/msr/plan/ownership.json; legacy RWB-E2-043 sections 3, 12 and 13
section: 3 Preconditions; 12.2 REST operations consumed; 12.8 Contract fakes; 13 Solution plan
description: No source read gives the harness repository and its SIT environment, the seeding set and script for the synthetic case and the two RESTRUCTURE versions, the evidence format of a run and its retention, or the pass or fail gate of a wave 2 integration run; it also gives no exact response values for the rwb-case, rwb-decision, rwb-source-data and case-event fakes. The ownership map holds no outbox delivery read for rwb-case, so the retry of a failed signal can only be asserted through the absence of the effect and the same event key on rwb.case.events.v1.
evidence: No source read gives these values; ownership.json gives owners, tables, events, workflows and operations only, and its outbox reads sit with P2 rwb-integration (GET /admin/outbox/deliveries), not with P3 rwb-case
proposed: The integration lead agrees the harness repository, the SIT environment, the seeding set and its script, the per-run evidence format and its retention, and the pass or fail gate with QA at the wave 2 entry check, and confirms the fake answers from the published OpenAPI documents and event schemas; the missing rwb-case outbox delivery read is either added to the rwb-case contract by RWB-P3-E2043-APP or the retry stays asserted through the effect and the event key, and the choice is recorded before the harness is declared Done.
